RECORDED PERCUSSION — Mr. Drew’s Orff Studio

Finger Cymbals #1 — Joseph SARDIN / BigSoundBank.com
Source: https://bigsoundbank.com/finger-cymbals-1-s2274.html
License: CC0-1.0, https://bigsoundbank.com/licenses.html
Original: https://bigsoundbank.com/UPLOAD/bwf-en/2274.wav
Trimmed 45ms leading silence, gain 0.72, gentle final 250ms fade,
resampled to44.1kHz and encoded as high-quality VBR MP3. Natural tail retained.

Gong1, mf — Versilian Studios LLC / Versilian Community Sample Library
Source: https://versilian-studios.com/vcsl/
Repository: https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
Commit: c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e
Original: Idiophones/Struck Idiophones/Gong 1/gong_mf.wav
License: CC0-1.0 (included in CC0-1.0.txt)
Trimmed10ms leading silence, gain3.85, gentle final394ms fade,
encoded as high-quality44.1kHz stereo VBR MP3. Full34-second decay retained.

No pitch shifting, looping, or synthesized replacements were applied to the finger cymbals or gong.
Exact source/output hashes and metadata are in ../manifest.json.

Tubanos: user-provided Real Tubano Drums recordings reused from Boomwhacker Creator Edition v1.65. High = sample 1 (ID 141), medium = sample 2 (ID 128), low = sample 3 (ID 142). Embedded MP3 bytes and individual playback gains preserved. No new license assertion.

Hand drums — Versilian Studios LLC / Versilian Community Sample Library
Source: https://versilian-studios.com/vcsl/
Repository: https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
Commit: c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e
Original folder: Membranophones/Struck Membranophones/Frame Drum/
Original file: HDrumS_Hit_v3_rr1_Sum.wav
License: CC0-1.0 (included in CC0-1.0.txt)
All five registers derive from the SAME small frame-drum hit by playback-rate resampling:
Highest = original pitch; high = -3 semitones; middle = -6;
low = -9; lowest = -12. Peak normalized to 0.70
before high-quality stereo 44.1kHz VBR MP3 encoding. Full pitch-scaled
decay retained, with a final 80ms fade. No loops or synthesized toms.
Source/output SHA-256 hashes and decoded measurements: ../manifest.json.
Rebuild: scripts/audio/build_hand_drums.py.
